$Comment: What a participant sees the instant the Blight Warden falls: the gate is theirs, and beneath it
their own share of the fight. The Warden's binding row points its Defeated beat here
(Feedback.Defeated), so the words belong to this fight alone.
The moment fires once per participant the fight credited and carries 'share' (that reader's
credited share of the fight as whole percent points, the top contributor reading 100) and
'seconds' (how long the Warden stood). The second line is the library's own share line, which
ships translated in every language the library does, so it reads right on a client the Warden's
own lines are not translated for yet. The round pays its spoils at the end of the night, so
there is no reward row here to list.
